name: What factors determine the cost of installing window casing?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of installing window casing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost depends on the linear footage, material choice, profile complexity, and whether jamb extensions or drywall repairs are required. Basic paint-grade MDF or pine casing on standard rectangular windows is the most economical approach. Hardwood profiles, stain-grade wood, or custom architectural millwork increase material costs significantly. If the existing window jamb sits recessed behind the drywall surface, carpenters must fabricate and install custom jamb extensions before the trim can be nailed in place. Combined finish carpentry and interior painting packages also reduce overall per-window finishing costs compared to separate trades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on linear footage, wood versus MDF materials, profile complexity, and whether jamb extensions or drywall patching are needed before painting.
